ScaleDifference.description: Dimensionless increment s in scale factor 1+s, not ppm or the full factor. Zero means no scale change; display precision 1e-12 does not round stored values.

constraints: Scale difference is not the full scale factor. SI value 1e-6 corresponds to one part per million.
Do not apply 0.001 meaningful display precision: it would conceal common geodetic scale differences.
Meaningful display precision is owned by the HelmertScaleDifference quantity; it is not transformation accuracy.

Accuracy.description: Estimated operation accuracy in SI metres; null means unknown, not zero or a guaranteed standard deviation.

constraints: Null means unknown, not zero. No standard-deviation or confidence-level interpretation is implied.

AreaOfUseBounds.description: WGS84/Greenwich geographic bounds in SI radians; west greater than east denotes antimeridian crossing.

constraints: West may exceed east for an antimeridian-crossing extent. Longitude boundaries are not always numeric lower and upper bounds.

InverseFlattening.description: Dimensionless inverse flattening 1/f; zero is the provider sphere sentinel, otherwise greater than one. Display precision 1e-9 does not round stored values.
